messages.subject: Project Quartz - mutual NDA
messages.plaintextBody:
Eleanor,

We act for Ardenfield Capital Partners in connection with the proposed acquisition of Whitmore Thermal Components Limited. Please find attached our form of mutual NDA. Subject to your client's agreement we'd propose to sign today and open the data room thereafter.

James Osei

--
Whitfield Carter LLP, 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
